<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant peak at m/z 121 with a ~8 % +1 peak and rapidly decreasing higher‑mass peaks—the distribution matches the binomial pattern expected for a molecule containing only carbon (≈7 C atoms). No other element shows its characteristic isotopic spacing or intensity ratios, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
